name: Elegoo Centauri Carbon 1
author: 3d-tlac-infra contributors
description: Shows CC1 filament and CANVAS slots over SDCP and tracks measured usage for single-spool prints.

mainboard_id.title: SDCP Mainboard ID (optional)
mainboard_id.description: Allows the driver to request a status snapshot before the printer sends its first status frame.

low_filament_threshold_g.title: Low filament threshold (g)
low_filament_threshold_g.description: Warn when a linked spool reaches this weight. Set to 0 to turn off the warning.
